reasoning: This project is a Kubernetes operator. It defines two CRDs (ExternalModel and ExternalProvider under inference.opendatahub.io), uses sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime to run reconciliation controllers, and creates derived Kubernetes resources (Service, ServiceEntry, DestinationRule, HTTPRoute) in response to custom resource changes. The operator also functions as an Inference Payload Processor (IPP) plugin for the AI Gateway, handling request/response mutations via Envoy ext_proc, but its core pattern is a controller-runtime-based operator managing custom resources.
